Memberships Programs Our medical spa membership programs are designed for patients who value personalized care, consistency, and exclusive access. Membership offers an elevated experience that supports both aesthetic and wellness goals under the guidance of licensed medical professionals. Elevated Aesthetic & Wellness Care By joining, patients become part of a select community that receives enhanced value, VIP consideration, and priority access to special opportunities throughout the year. VIP-exclusive discounts not available to the general public Invitations to members-only events , promotions, and practice offerings Personalized , provider-guided care tailored to individual goals Priority communication and updates on new treatments and offerings All care remains subject to medical evaluation, provider approval, and clinical appropriateness. Personalized, Clinically Guided Experience We believe aesthetic and wellness treatments should never be one-size-fits-all. Membership does not replace a medical consultation and does not guarantee outcomes. Treatment recommendations are always individualized based on clinical assessment and patient goals. Membership availability, benefits, and terms may vary and are reviewed with patients prior to enrollment. Learn More About Membership Options To ensure accuracy and individualized guidance, specific membership details are provided directly by our team. To learn more or determine whether a membership is right for you, we invite you to contact our office.
